title: Identification of small molecule antagonists of sonic hedgehog/heparin binding with activity in hedgehog functional assays.
authors: Lamson, David R; Tarpley, Michael; Addo, Kezia; Ji, Xiaojia; Abu Rabe, Dina; Ehe, Ben; Hughes, Mark; Smith, Ginger R; Daye, Laura R; Musso, David L; Zheng, Weifan; Williams, Kevin P
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. General subjects
one_liner_zh: 该文筛选小分子拮抗剂阻断Shh与肝素结合，并用分子对接验证结合，但核心是蛋白-糖胺聚糖互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Sonic hedgehog (Shh) is a morphogen with important roles in embryonic development and in the development of a number of cancers. Its activity is modulated by interactions with binding partners and co-receptors including heparin and heparin sulfate proteoglycans (HSPG). To identify antagonists of Shh/heparin binding, a diverse collection of 34,560 chemicals was screened in single point 384-well format. We identified and confirmed twenty six novel small molecule antagonists with diverse structures including four scaffolds that gave rise to multiple hits. Nineteen of the confirmed hits blocked binding of the N-terminal fragment of Shh (ShhN) to heparin with IC(50) values < 50 muM. In the Shh-responsive C3H10T1/2 cell model, four of the compounds demonstrated the ability to block ShhN-induced alkaline phosphatase activity. To demonstrate a direct and selective effect on ShhN ligand mediated activity, two of the compounds were able to block induction of Gli1 mRNA, a primary downstream marker for Shh signaling activity, in Shh-mediated but not Smoothened agonist (SAG)-mediated C3H10T1/2 cells. Direct binding of the two compounds to ShhN was confirmed by thermal shift assay and molecular docking simulations, with both compounds docking with the N-terminal heparin binding domain of Shh. Overall, our findings indicate that small molecule compounds that block ShhN binding to heparin and act to inhibit Shh mediated activity in vitro can be identified. We propose that the interaction between Shh and HSPGs provides a novel target for identifying small molecules that bind Shh, potentially leading to novel tool compounds to probe Shh ligand function.
abstract_zh: 音速刺猬因子（Sonic hedgehog, Shh）是一种形态发生素，在胚胎发育及多种癌症的发展中发挥重要作用。其活性通过与结合伙伴和共受体（包括肝素和硫酸肝素蛋白聚糖（HSPG））的相互作用进行调节。为识别Shh/肝素结合的拮抗剂，我们在单点384孔格式下筛选了包含34,560种化学物质的多样化集合。我们鉴定并确认了26种新型小分子拮抗剂，其结构多样，包括四种产生多个命中物的骨架。其中19个确认的命中物阻断了Shh N端片段（ShhN）与肝素的结合，IC(50)值小于50 μM。在Shh响应的C3H10T1/2细胞模型中，四种化合物表现出阻断ShhN诱导的碱性磷酸酶活性的能力。为证明对ShhN配体介导活性的直接和选择性效应，其中两种化合物能够阻断Shh介导的C3H10T1/2细胞中Gli1 mRNA（Shh信号活性的主要下游标志物）的诱导，但在Smoothened激动剂（SAG）介导的细胞中无此作用。通过热位移实验和分子对接模拟确认了这两种化合物与ShhN的直接结合，且两种化合物均对接至Shh的N端肝素结合域。总体而言，我们的发现表明，能够阻断ShhN与肝素结合并在体外抑制Shh介导活性的小分子化合物可以被识别。我们提出，Shh与HSPG之间的相互作用为识别结合Shh的小分子提供了新靶点，可能有助于开发探测Shh配体功能的新型工具化合物。
